description: This file defines the Controller class within the OpenCart framework, responsible for managing registry objects and providing magic methods for property access.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: A class that interfaces with the Registry to facilitate controlled access to shared objects within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Controller with a Registry instance.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve objects from the registry by key, throws exception if key does not exist.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set objects in the registry by key.
